summary.en-US: Fill logins and passkeys from the Vaultkeeper app, a native client for self-hosted Vaultwarden servers. macOS now; Windows and Linux are coming soon.

description.en-US:
Vaultkeeper fills logins and passkeys on web pages from the Vaultkeeper desktop app, a lightweight native client for self-hosted Vaultwarden servers, and offers to save new passwords.

The extension is a thin client. It never holds your vault, your master password or a list of logins: each request goes to the app over native messaging, and the app shows its own window to choose a login.

Requires the Vaultkeeper app on macOS 13 or newer (Apple silicon): https://github.com/avbel/vaultkeeper/releases

Windows and Linux are coming soon.

Vaultkeeper is an independent project, not affiliated with Bitwarden Inc. or the Vaultwarden project.

version.approval_notes:
Works only together with the Vaultkeeper desktop app (native messaging host org.vaultkeeper.browser), currently macOS only.

The uploaded add-on is minified. To rebuild it from the attached source: Node.js 24 and pnpm 12.18.0, then in the browsers/ directory run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run package`. The add-on is built into dist/firefox.
